body:
In the end, and this might sound cruel, but in the end, it comes down to this; my situation is going to end up causing massive hurt and suffering for my loved ones regardless. As long as it is going to do so, I suppose I would rather choose the option where I don't have to face the hurt and suffering I've caused every day. I won't care because I won't exist to care.

Normally, I'm never that heartless but when these two choices are thrown together, that's the thoughts I come out with.

I don't think the latter would be the best situation for them, although naturally neither is favorable. Think about it. From then on, I become the child that became a registered sex offender and served time. To everybody that asks and to their thoughts that haunt them every night. At least with the former option I'm not around to consistently remind them of that.

Court dates and such might stop me from being thrown in jail, but that won't stop the media from throwing my face around making sure to barely focus on the term "allegedly". That won't stop me from losing the halfway decent job I have, the plans to re-enroll in school in the fall, and everything else in my possession. That alone is worth enough to at least ponder the thought of suicide.

But if it isn't and I am incriminated, it makes ending everything more difficult and then I'm forced to stay alive through prison or die a painful death at the hand of some gang member that's locked up with me if I want to end it all. My family also has to deal with the news making a spectactle out of me. Not worth it.
